name: 1-play.jpg
shows: Wave 7 of 10, the most striking moment of ten autopilot runs: a thick Verdant main beam (lit in the colour bar) bounces off two mirror shards while its Prism branches in Ember and Azure reflect off another, the split striking Shades of different colours at once, each with its hit flash and stacked score popups. 16 Shades on the field and none hidden under a panel, combo x3, and the teaching HUD: CORE 12/12 with '0 = RUN LOST', 'HOLD 3 MORE WAVES · THEN THE ECLIPSE', INCOMING with counts, an event log, the 'MATCH THE BEAM TO THE SHADE' strip and the named build.

name: 2-title.jpg
shows: The title screen: logo, tagline, '10 waves · 6 kinds of Shade · 9 upgrades · a three-phase boss', a live reflected beam show, controls, RULES OF LIGHT opening with 'Match the beam to the Shade's colour', BEST SCORE 28,410 and 'Click to begin'.

name: 3-upgrade.jpg
shows: The moment before the boss: WAVE 9 CLEARED with a large 'NEXT: THE ECLIPSE' preview drawn by the boss's own renderer and its three phases (UMBRA, PENUMBRA, TOTALITY) named one per line, above three upgrade cards with icon, level, effect and how each combines with the build, plus Core, score and YOUR BUILD.

name: 4-results.jpg
shows: VICTORY with THE ECLIPSE drawn small beneath it, dimmed and cracked, then the stats (waves, Shades dispelled, colour accuracy, best combo, time), score 32,925 marked NEW BEST over the previous 28,410, the build taken by name and level, and 'Press R or click to play again'.
